notes.text: The song is from Tang Xian-zu’s The Handan Dream, where the immortal He Xian-gu addresses Lü Dong-bin.
Tumi is a climbing, rose-like flower that blooms late in spring.

anchor.text: When tumi blooms, the season of flowers is done.

notes.text: The double-pupilled lord is Xiang Yu; Qing Bu is Ying Bu. Commandant Shi is Shi Chong, Green Pearl’s patron. Lord Yang is Yang Su, whom Red Whisk leaves for Li Jing. The poems freely recast received stories.

anchor.text: ‘Each found a view of his own, unlike anyone else’s. Cousin Lin’s five poems today may also be said to have fresh conceptions and to open up new ground.’
